name: Tipo de Precio de Venta Unitario
source: Anexo 8 (catálogo 16) from the 'Catálogos' sheet of perunio-facturador/resources/reglas/reglas-validacion-cpe-2026-08-26.xlsx. Código 03 was wrong until v1.1.0: it read 'Valor referencial unitario en operaciones de exportación', which is not a Cat.16 concept at all. SUNAT says 'Tarifas reguladas' — the regulated tariff a servicio público charges. flags.referencial went false with it: a regulated tariff is the price actually charged, unlike 02, which is the referencial standing in for a price on a gratuito. Nothing consumes the flag today; 03 keeps `emit` because perunio-facturador's internal/xmlbuilder/invoice.go gates PriceTypeCode on Cat16Emit.

entries.label: Valor referencial
entries.description: Valor referencial unitario en operaciones no onerosas (Gratuitas)
